title: Gluten-Free Japanese Chicken Tagine
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of Japan and North Africa. Chicken is marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, sake, and spices, then cooked in a tagine with vegetables and served over rice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the carrots, zucchini, green beans, and dried apricots. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sake, tagine spice mix, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken and vegetables over rice.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
